title: Trent Van Lannen NICB Employment Warner Robins PD

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Part-time appointment. Trent Van Lannen’s oath or commission for his part-time peace-officer position, with the date it began, and the most recent version of the department’s Personnel / Call Signs List.

2. Outside employment. Any request, approval or disclosure form on file for Mr. Van Lannen, dated January 1, 2023 to today, that mentions outside employment. Please also send the department’s written policy on outside or secondary employment for part-time officers in effect during that period.

3. Flock account. Any form, ticket, memo or other document showing who requested or approved Mr. Van Lannen’s Flock Safety account and the date it was created. If you cannot find one, a screenshot or report from the Flock administrator console showing only the account’s creation date and the date of any later role change is enough if that is possible. There should be an event in the "event logs" of  Flock which will show this, available as an export by  the Flock admin at WRPD.

4. Training. Records sufficient to show the dates of Mr. Van Lannen’s LPR/Flock training and his current GCIC/CJIS certification/

I am not asking the City to answer questions, create a list or summarize anything. Please redact home addresses, Social Security numbers, medical information and anything else exempt by law, cite the specific exemption for each redaction, and release the rest.

Please do not begin work that will cost more than $10 until you send me a written estimate, broken down by item, with the hours, hourly rate and job classification. I would like to approve each item separately.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar
